about.imageAlt: Creative professionals connecting at AFRIQA Creative Showcase
about.heading: A meeting point for talent and opportunity
about.p1: Abuja's creative community spans film, music, fashion, photography, publishing, theatre, visual arts, gaming, and technology — but the ecosystem is fragmented. Talent is here. Connection to capital, markets, and decision-makers often isn't.
about.p2: Afriqa Creative Showcase brings the two together over two days: creative markets, screenings, live performances, industry conversations, masterclasses, a finance forum, and a pitching room, all in one space.

convener.imageAlt: Paulgold Olalekan Joseph, Convener of AFRIQA Creative Showcase
convener.quote: Africa has never lacked creativity. What we need are stronger spaces where that creativity can connect, collaborate, and become opportunity.
convener.p1: AFRIQA Creative Showcase was created from a simple belief: our creative industries become stronger when talent, ideas, capital, and opportunity meet in the same space.
convener.p2: This showcase is more than a gathering. It is an invitation to discover new voices, build meaningful connections, open doors, and create the partnerships that move African creativity forward.
convener.p3: Abuja gives us the meeting point. The creatives bring the energy. Together, we create the ecosystem.

ecosystem.heading: Where creative worlds meet.
ecosystem.intro: AFRIQA brings different parts of the creative economy into one connected space — creating room for collaboration, discovery, investment, and new opportunities.

faq.heading: Questions people ask.
faq.intro: Everything you need to know before joining the Showcase.

q1.q: Who is Afriqa Creative Showcase for?
q1.a: Creatives across film, music, fashion, art, publishing, gaming, and digital media; industry stakeholders like production companies, labels and distributors; investors and funding institutions; and the general public.

q2.a: Registration is open. Attendee, Exhibitor, and Pitching spots are confirmed as soon as you pay. Press and Investor spots go through an application and review process.

q3.q: Is there a fee to attend?
q3.a: General entry is free and covers both days. VIP is ₦20,000 with priority seating, the Masterclass Pass is ₦50,000 and includes the masterclasses on both days, and VVIP is ₦150,000 and includes everything: front reserved seating, a reserved table at the concert and dinner, a meet and greet, the masterclasses, and Pitch and Deal Room access.

q4.q: Can my organization exhibit or sponsor?
q4.a: Yes. Exhibitors can choose a Normal booth (₦200,000), a Double booth (₦300,000, with space to display your art), or the Fashion Runway (₦300,000). Sponsorship packages are also available — check back here or use the contact details in the footer.
